_meta.status: HYPOTHETICAL software test inputs; no engineering approval implied

conventions.time_axis: Integer ticks from project_start (local Europe/Madrid, +01:00 in the horizon). Tick i covers [start + i*tick, start + (i+1)*tick).
conventions.resolution: 5-minute tick is the proposed default for new cases; R0-15 retains the existing 15-minute regression. Every calendar boundary is a multiple of the tick.
conventions.rounding: Durations and lags are rounded UP to whole ticks; raw minutes are kept in duration_minutes.
conventions.activity_calendar: Intersection of the calendars of all renewable resources the activity uses; the project calendar when it uses none; then intersected with allowed_hours.
conventions.elapsed_hold: No resources, no calendar. Runs through nights, weekends and holidays.
conventions.reservation: kind=reservation resources are occupied continuously (calendar 'continuous') from from_activity start to to_activity finish, including holds and non-working time.
conventions.supply: Concrete supply is a renewable rate resource (m3/h) on its own delivery calendar; each pour demands its drawn rate for its whole duration. Duration = volume / min(placement, supply rate).
conventions.split: split_allowed activities work every available tick of their calendar from their start until complete (no voluntary pause inside an available window); segment rules then accept or reject the start. A solver that additionally permits voluntary pauses may only match or improve the objective; none of these cases has contention that would benefit from it.

statuses.OPTIMAL: Feasible and proven optimal by the stated method.
statuses.FEASIBLE (not optimal): Satisfies every constraint but a better schedule exists.
statuses.INFEASIBLE: Proven that no schedule satisfies the constraints.
statuses.MODEL_INVALID: Input incomplete or inconsistent; reject before solving.

general_acceptance_criteria: Expected status: OPTIMAL cases must return OPTIMAL (FEASIBLE with the same objective is reported as 'feasible, optimality not proven' and fails the case). INFEASIBLE cases must return INFEASIBLE or a preflight rejection with the stated code, never UNKNOWN or a relaxed schedule. MODEL_INVALID cases must be rejected before the solver is invoked.
Objective: makespan in minutes from project_start equals optimal_makespan_minutes exactly.
Schedule: dates may differ from reference_schedule only where unique_optimal_schedule is false. Any returned schedule must be validated independently against all constraints below.

Durations: every productive or inspection activity occupies exactly ceil(duration_minutes / tick) ticks of working time; elapsed holds occupy exactly ceil(duration_minutes / tick) ticks of elapsed time.
Calendars: every occupied tick lies inside the calendar of every resource the activity uses (or the project calendar when it uses none) and inside allowed_hours where declared.

Capacity: at every tick, the sum of demands on each resource is at most its capacity on that tick (capacity is 0 outside the resource calendar). Reservations count from from_activity start to to_activity finish, continuously.
Precedence: successor start >= predecessor finish + lag (FS, elapsed).
Deadlines: every finish is at or before its latest_finish.
Interruption: only split_allowed activities may have more than one segment, with at most max_segments segments each of at least min_segment_minutes; resources are held only during segments.

cases.notes: Sum 600 scheduled min > 480 min shift. Non-interruptible. The shortest activity must go to day 2. Longest-first and shortest-first heuristics differ.

expected.acceptance_criteria: general_acceptance_criteria apply; status and makespan must match; any constraint-valid optimal schedule is accepted
